reply_text: I replied to Marcus in his DM to confirm his standing call with Quarrendon Freight Lines is now Thursdays at 16:30. I also told him I can't save notes between conversations, so I can't promise to remember it later. Instead, I offered to put a recurring Thursday 16:30 event on his calendar, with anyone on the account he'd like invited. Nothing else was changed, since he said no action was needed.
